title: USC Affordability: Financial Aid Expansion and Tuition-Free Policy
text:
Note: the tuition-free policy on this page applies to new first-year students entering in Fall 2020.

OVERALL AID
- USC is committing over $30 million in additional aid annually, expanding its current $640 million financial aid pool. The $640 million is total aid from all sources awarded annually to undergraduates.
- Two out of three undergraduates receive some form of aid, and 21% of them come from low-income families.
- The additional funding allows USC to provide stronger assistance to more than 4,000 students each year.

TUITION-FREE POLICY (new first-year students entering Fall 2020)
- Students from U.S. families with an annual income of $80,000 or less with typical assets attend USC tuition free.
- The initiative is meant to keep need-based grant funding growing faster than annual tuition growth.
